opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid OneCoin packages ranging from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000 within a recruitment-based compensation plan. It describes a binary structure in which viewers may refer people to two sides, with earnings tied to the weaker side’s volume, while also presenting commissions from direct sales and multiple generations of recruits. The material further links purchased coins to speculative appreciation and account-doubling projections, including claims that a EUR 5,030 package could grow to tens of thousands or more. An extraordinary income claim says that over 135 people are making EUR 140,000 per month. The presentation then urges viewers to “partner with our team today.” Recruitment-dependent earnings, high-income claims, speculative returns, and immediate participation pressure make this an active solicitation rather than neutral cryptocurrency education.
